predecessors.name: Bagratid Armenia
predecessors.text: the province of Tashir, granted to Kiurike by his brother Smbat II in 979

successors.name: Kingdom of Georgia
successors.text: Lori and Agarak, captured and annexed by David IV in 1118

ledger.x: 979: Smbat II grants Tashir to his brother Kiurike with the title of king, founding the Kingdom of Tashir-Dzoraget.
1064: Kiurike II moves the capital from Matsnaberd to Lori.
1118: Tashir-Dzoraget is annexed to the Kingdom of Georgia.

wars.name: Revolt of David I Anhoghin
wars.outcome: David I Anhoghin 'unsuccessfully tried to gain independence from the Bagratid kings'; Gagik I took his possessions, which earned David the name Anhoghin (landless).

wars.name: David IV's capture of Lori
wars.outcome: David IV captured Lori and Agarak in 1118 and annexed Tashir-Dzoraget.

certainty.note: The page gives no boundary; Lori province stands in for the Tashir and Dzoraget districts.
